description: This file defines the PHP class 'Register' within the OpenCart system, specifically within the Catalog Controller Mail namespace. The class handles email-related functionalities for user registration events, including sending registration confirmation emails and admin alerts. The file contains methods for initializing and sending emails, as well as alerting admin about new registrations.

classes.name: Register
classes.description: A controller class responsible for handling email notifications related to user registration processes, including sending welcome emails and admin alerts within the OpenCart platform.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method that constructs and sends registration confirmation emails to the user, and optionally, notification emails to the admin.

methods.name: alert
methods.description: Sends alert emails to admin addresses when a new user registers, based on configuration settings.
